name: 98221 · Anacortes, WA
findings: ZIP 98221 (Anacortes) has 106 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 43 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (19% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98221 (Anacortes) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 98221 (Anacortes) list membership in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.7 times the typical level).
